findings.message: reads a browser global during render or module scope, where no SSR guard applies
findings.remediation: Move the access into useEffect/useLayoutEffect, or guard it with a typeof window !== "undefined" check. Render and module scope both execute during server rendering, so a bare window/document reference throws there — and because it throws at import time it takes down the whole route, not just this component.
